# Hiriq

> Hiriq is an AI-powered recruitment platform for resume screening, applicant tracking workflows, automated candidate pre-screening, AI interviews, and evidence-backed hiring shortlists.

## What Hiriq Does

- Helps recruiters create structured job and screening criteria.
- Screens resumes against role requirements.
- Supports branded candidate application flows.
- Runs automated candidate pre-screening and AI interview steps.
- Gives recruiters transcripts, summaries, scoring context, and shortlist evidence.
- Supports hiring teams operating across the United States, United Kingdom, Middle East, Pakistan, Qatar, UAE, and remote markets.
